justification: Assessment returned INVALID at step 0031, the same step the ground truth targets: evaluating 2n <= 8(k-1)/(k-4) at k=5. It independently reproduces all three components of the verified witness: (A) the correct RHS is 8*(5-1)/1 = 32, not the printed 8*5/1 = 40; (B) under either reading (32 or 40) the value is far below 2n = 2024, so the asserted strict inequality is numerically false; (C) as written the inequality points the wrong way, so no contradiction and hence no k<=4 follows. It also flags the ground truth's secondary target (step 0055, the n=3, k=10 equality condition 'every element appears in exactly 3 subsets'), correctly noting the true per-element count is kn/(2n) = 5 and that the proof's own construction in 0059 and the average 5.5 in 0065 contradict the stated 3. Same defect, correct supporting arithmetic.
